entries.title: Genesis 12:1
segments: ¶Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

entries.title: Genesis 12:2
segments: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

words.text: And I will make of thee
; and thou shalt be a blessing

entries.title: Genesis 12:3
segments: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.

words.text: thee: and in thee shall all families

entries.title: Genesis 12:4
segments: ¶So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram [was] seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.

entries.title: Genesis 12:5
segments: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

entries.title: Genesis 12:6
segments: ¶And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite [was] then in the land. {plain: Heb. plains}

entries.title: Genesis 12:7
segments: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.

entries.title: Genesis 12:8
segments: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, [having] Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 12:9
segments: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south. {going...: Heb. in going and journeying}

entries.title: Genesis 12:10
segments: ¶And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine [was] grievous in the land.

entries.title: Genesis 12:11
segments: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou [art] a fair woman to look upon:

words.text: And it came to pass, when

entries.title: Genesis 12:12
segments: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This [is] his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.

words.text: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians
me, but they will save thee alive

entries.title: Genesis 12:13
segments: Say, I pray thee, thou [art] my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.

words.text: with me for thy sake; and my soul

entries.title: Genesis 12:14
segments: ¶And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she [was] very fair.

words.text: ¶And it came to pass, that, when Abram

entries.title: Genesis 12:15
segments: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.

entries.title: Genesis 12:16
segments: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.

words.text: for her sake: and he had sheep

entries.title: Genesis 12:17
segments: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.

entries.title: Genesis 12:18
segments: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What [is] this [that] thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she [was] thy wife?

words.text: unto me? why didst thou not tell

entries.title: Genesis 12:19
segments: Why saidst thou, She [is] my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take [her], and go thy way.

entries.title: Genesis 12:20
segments: And Pharaoh commanded [his] men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.

words.text: concerning him: and they sent him away
